verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Square is a SaaS platform holding seller and customer data, and it ships AI features (Square AI, ML fraud detection), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a data-use control, or a policy against using customer data for model training. The Square AI and MCP items describe AI features and access scopes, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.
